card.name: Words before 'stand' or 'sit' unused
card.fires_on: Small linking words (has, it, to, let, not) right before an expected 'stand', 'sit' or 'not been used' about a product left sitting. It appears in preparation and priming directions.

modes.label: Priming after non-use
modes.description: Helper word after an inhaler or pump subject, before 'not been used for' a number of days.
modes.example: Prime the inhaler before using for the first time and when the inhaler<< has>> not been used for more than 3

modes.label: Let it stand
modes.description: Word before 'stand' in directions to leave a preparation or solution undisturbed or unused.
modes.example: allow the preparation<< to>> stand for 15 minutes after mixing
